slides.main: Diarrhea after eating? 4 things worth checking.
slides.sub: From timing to sugar-free gum, and when to get help.

slides.main: Diarrhea, sometimes with a sudden urge to go, is a main IBS symptom.
slides.sub: Alcohol, caffeine and spicy or fatty food can trigger IBS flare-ups.

slides.main: Food intolerance symptoms usually start a few hours after eating.
slides.sub: So diarrhea in the evening can come from lunch.

slides.main: Sorbitol and other sugar alcohols may cause diarrhea in some people.
slides.sub: In the EU and UK, foods with over 10% added polyols carry a laxative warning.

slides.main: Bile acid diarrhea is an often overlooked cause.
slides.sub: Up to 30% of people with diarrhea-type IBS show signs of it on testing.

slides.main: Get medical help if you have:
items: Blood in your stool or black stools
